niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, high-contrast interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, concise copy, and clearly separated sections. They like layouts that feel polished and intentional rather than busy or cluttered, with enough content to feel complete but not so much that the screen feels dense. They generally prefer light themes in settings/onboarding contexts, but will accept dark modal/alert surfaces when the dialog is focused and uncluttered. They also favor prominent, easy-to-scan primary actions and simple, readable controls over decorative or overly complex UI.

criteria.description: Clear headline-first structure with one dominant focal area and secondary content clearly subordinated.
Spacious layouts with moderate content density, balanced whitespace, and fewer competing elements on screen.
Distinct, well-bounded sections or grouped categories that make the page feel organized and easy to scan.
Short, direct, task-oriented copy with minimal verbosity or tip-heavy explanation.
A clean, modern, refined look with low visual noise and a finished, intentional feel.
A prominent, easy-to-find primary CTA or next-step action that is visually anchored and immediately actionable.
Screens that feel fully populated and complete, with enough visible rows, options, or sections to avoid an unfinished or empty impression.
Controls presented in a straightforward, readable way, with clear toggle states and minimal decorative complexity.
Bright, airy, high-contrast surfaces that improve readability and make the interface feel clearer and lighter.
Modal and alert screens that isolate the task, reduce background distraction, and keep attention on the dialog content.
